summary: Full regression + new wallet-auth + SSE-error-frame + /account gate verification. All 16 backend pytest tests pass (6 relay GETs, strategies shape, AI generate (200/429 tolerant), eth-long backtest, 6 new auth tests: challenge shape+required-wallet, verify bad_signature=401, consumed-challenge replay=400 no_challenge, GET /me/strategies without token=401 and with token=200). SSE error framing verified end-to-end: curl -N on /api/relay/ai/generate/stream currently yields `event: error\ndata: {"error":"You've drafted 5 strategies today without an account…"}` (upstream anon cap hit, which is the exact scenario we needed to prove). Frontend: /, /strategies, /strategies/eth-long, /traders, /leaderboard, /revenue all load with zero console errors; header shows 'Weft.' logo + Strategies/Traders/Leaderboard/Revenue + Connect button (data-testid=header-account-btn, text 'Connect' while disconnected) + Start trading. /account disconnected renders data-testid=account-connect-btn. /new happy path couldn't be tested (upstream cap exhausted on this preview IP) but the new draft-error banner (data-testid=draft-error) renders exactly as designed with a user-friendly message. Only observable issue: served index.html had stale <meta name=description> referencing MakeMarkets even though source file was correct — fixed by restarting frontend supervisor (dev-server HTML cache), now serves Weft description.

issues: Stale <meta name=description> ('MakeMarkets — market makers for every coin…') was being served from webpack-dev-server cache despite source file being correct; cleared by frontend supervisor restart. Main agent should ensure a production build (yarn build) uses the current /app/frontend/public/index.html so this doesn't recur in prod.

action_items: No functional blockers. (Optional) ensure production build picks up current /app/frontend/public/index.html so meta description stays Weft-branded in deployed artifacts — the dev-server was serving a stale cached HTML until I restarted supervisor.

AI happy path on /new cannot be verified from this preview IP until the upstream anon daily cap (5/day) resets or a signed-in request is used; the error banner surface is confirmed working so this is cosmetic for test coverage, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments:
server.py SSE relay now correctly reframes non-SSE / non-200 upstream responses as `event: error
data: …

` — matches the fix spec. Minor: body.replace(b'
', b' ') flattens multi-line JSON which is fine for the current single-line error payload but could truncate nested newlines in future errors; consider base64 or JSON-escape instead.
auth_verify stores session tokens in `db.sessions` without TTL and `_session_wallet` doesn't check expiry — tokens live forever. Low priority but worth an index + TTL in a future pass.
auth_challenge upserts per wallet so parallel sign-in attempts clobber each other's nonces. Acceptable for a single-tab wallet flow; document the assumption.
server.py `_http` lazy client is still unused by the /stream branch (expected, since it needs a per-request stream context). No action required.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_weft_relay.py (expanded from 10 to 16 tests — added 6 auth tests using /app/scripts/test_wallet.json keypair + solders.Keypair.sign_message)
restarted frontend supervisor to flush stale dev-server index.html cache
test_credentials: No email/password. Wallet auth tests use /app/scripts/test_wallet.json (pubkey 3eh2VqePVP1NLHbMvjRfuVBV4EmikQi98WXNc7eMABJQ) with solders Keypair.sign_message for ed25519 signatures.
seed_data_creation: Each auth test creates one row in db.auth_challenges (consumed on verify) and db.sessions on success; last test leaves one session token for the test wallet.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_weft_relay.py has 16 passing tests. Auth: challenge/verify use ed25519 (solders), nonces are one-time (deleted on successful verify). /me/strategies and /me/strategies POST require Bearer token. SSE error framing is implemented in server.py:55-70 and confirmed working via curl -N; frontend banner is data-testid=draft-error. Upstream anon AI cap (5/day/IP) means test_relay_ai_generate accepts 200 OR 429 and /new happy-path can't be headlessly observed on this preview IP — the error path IS observable and passes. /account gate: data-testid=account-connect-btn when disconnected, header button data-testid=header-account-btn shows 'Connect'/'Sign in'/'Account' states. Wallet signing itself requires a real browser wallet and remains out of scope for headless E2E.
rca_of_the_issue:
Previous iteration's silent-failure bug on /new is fully resolved. Reproduction: hit /api/relay/ai/generate/stream from preview IP after cap exhaustion → relay now detects non-SSE content-type / non-200 status, reads upstream body, and emits `event: error
data: <json>

`. Frontend New.jsx surfaces this via data-testid=draft-error banner with text 'The drafting engine is at its anonymous daily limit right now — try again later, or sign in for a higher allowance.' Verified visually at .screenshots/new.png.
